name: Curd Rice
summary: Soft, cooling curd rice designed for a small portion and a very soft texture.

items: ⅓ standard cup sona masuri rice (0.25 rice cup)
½ standard cup thick curd (0.375 rice cup)
¼ standard cup milk (0.1875 rice cup)

preparation.text: Rinse ⅓ standard cup sona masuri rice (0.25 rice cup).

items: ⅓ standard cup sona masuri rice (0.25 rice cup)

cookingMethod.text: Build pressure on the induction cooktop, then reduce to 100°C / 300 W for 10 minutes. Allow natural pressure release. The rice should be very soft.
Mash the hot cooked rice thoroughly. Allow it to cool until warm.

items: ¼ standard cup milk (0.1875 rice cup)
½ standard cup thick curd (0.375 rice cup)

cookingMethod.after: Allow the tempering ingredients to sizzle.
Mix well into the curd rice.

servingSuggestions: Serve at room temperature with pickle, pomegranate or grated carrot.
notes: The 1:3 rice-to-water ratio is intentional because the rice must become very soft for curd rice.
Add a little more milk or curd before serving if the rice thickens after resting.
